profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Independent
profile.summary:
I build software people interact with in real time: AAA console games, augmented reality apps, and VR platforms.
Right now I'm working solo at the intersection of AR and on-device AI: native iOS and Android, ARKit and ARCore, and scene understanding.
Before that I shipped AR features at Microsoft for Remote Assist Mobile, worked on Halo Infinite at 343 Industries, and built the core VR interaction systems for Sansar at Linden Lab in C++. Earlier, seven shipped game titles and the engines and tools behind them.
The thread is real-time systems under hard constraints — memory budgets, frame time, latency, fixed ship dates. Open to senior and principal roles in AR/XR, games, and applied AI. Seattle area.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building end-to-end AR + on-device AI prototypes solo — native iOS and Android, ARKit/ARCore, scene understanding, multimodal interaction, model integration, and inference performance tuning.

positions.description: Shipped AR features for Remote Assist Mobile on iOS and Android, including LiDAR-based spatial tracking and live screen sharing, while cutting the crash rate from over 5% to under 1% across 10+ store releases.
